meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把问题交给由 4-6 个不同思考原型（如建筑师、逆向者、经验主义者等）组成的议事会；每位成员陈述立场、推理、风险与洞见，最后输出综合结论（共识、核心张力、盲点、建议路径、置信度）。
howto.when: 当你想听多角度观点、做艰难决定，或说出“council mode”“mind council”等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我就“要不要辞职创业”召开一次议事会
say.note: 你会得到多位原型的分析对比和最终建议。

say.text: 用魔鬼代言人模式分析我的产品方案
say.note: 每个成员都会唱反调，帮你发现盲点。

say.text: 开个快速议事会，帮我在两个 offer 里选一个
say.note: 3 位成员快速审议，给出简短结论。

howto.what_en: Claude forms a council of 4-6 thinking archetypes (Architect, Contrarian, Empiricist, etc.) to debate your question. Each member gives position, reasoning, risk, and insight; then it synthesizes convergence, core tension, blind spots, recommended path, and confidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want diverse viewpoints, need help with a tough decision, say "council mode" or "mind council", or face a dilemma with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Help me run a council on whether I should quit my job to start a company.
say_en.note: You'll get multi-perspective analysis and a synthesized recommendation.

say_en.text: Use devil's advocate mode to rip apart my product plan.
say_en.note: Every member argues against the obvious, exposing blind spots.

say_en.text: Run a quick council to choose between two job offers.
say_en.note: Three members deliberate briefly and give a short synthesis.
